newsitem.title: CANADA: Continental Grain reorganizes Canadian operations.
newsitem.headline: Continental Grain reorganizes Canadian operations.

text.p: New York-based Continental Grain shut its Winnipeg office and transferred its Canadian commodity marketing to Vancouver and Minneapolis, a company statement said.
David Hogan, vice president of the Pacific subregion of Continental's North American Grain Division, was named president of Continental Grain Co (Canada) Ltd.

Murray Stow, who handles Canadian grains, feeds and special crops from Continental's Vancouver office, was named vice president and general manager of Continental Canada. John Bartsch in Minneapolis will handle North American pulse crops, the company said.
